'''FX-6''' was an [[FX-6 medical assistant droid]] manufactured by [[Medtech Industries/Legends|Medtech Industries]].

==History==
FX-6 was used during the extensive repairs to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] after a horrible [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash. During [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] reconstruction, the same FX-6 unit performed numerous [[Blood/Legends|blood]] transfusions, and stabilized terrible damage done to Vader's lungs, eyes, vocal cords, scalp, face, arms, and legs. This FX-6 was damaged by Darth Vader after the Dark Lord was told he had killed his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|wife]]. However, the droid appeared to be functional when Vader's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] blast ceased.
